description: Verifies that the expected dynamically-connected controller (e.g. the 7 syringe pump ESP32) is physically plugged into its USB port right now. Use this after swapping hardware onto a shared USB port so the workflow fails loudly instead of silently talking to the wrong device.

inputs.label: Controller
inputs.description: Which dynamically-connected controller (from the Hardware Map) should be plugged in right now.
